name: cosmos-sources-tools
description: Fetch, semantically filter, and locally render the complete current-day CLS telegraph feed.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch and filter today's CLS telegraph feed.
interface.longDescription: Retrieves the complete China Standard Time CLS telegraph feed for the current day, lets Codex apply a broad semantic filter, and writes selected source text unchanged to local Markdown with timestamps and links.
defaultPrompt: Fetch and filter today's AI-related CLS telegraph feed.
